summary: Comprehensive testing of BidBlitz V2 frontend-backend integration completed. All 22 backend API tests passed. All critical frontend flows tested and working: Login, Registration, Wallet, TopUp, Scanner Payment, Merchant Dashboard, More page, and Logout. Fixed api.js error handling for 'body stream already read' issue caused by emergent script intercepting fetch responses.

seed_data_creation: Admin user auto-seeded on backend startup with initial balance EUR 1,500.00
context_for_next_testing_agent: BidBlitz V2 is now fully integrated with real FastAPI+MongoDB backend. All contexts (User, Wallet, Merchant) make real API calls. Auth uses cookie-based JWT (httponly cookies). The api.js was updated to handle 'body stream already read' errors caused by emergent script intercepting fetch responses - it now falls back to status-based error messages. Admin balance may vary based on test transactions. Scanner payment deducts from wallet balance. TopUp adds to wallet balance. All transactions are persisted in MongoDB.

fix_applied.issue: Response body was being consumed by emergent-main.js script before api.js could read it, causing 'body stream already read' errors
fix_applied.solution: Added try-catch around response.text() parsing with fallback to status-based error messages (401 -> 'Invalid email or password', etc.)
